description: This file contains an Android Activity class 'FragmentLayout' demonstrating the use of fragments to implement different activity layouts, including nested secondary activities, multi-pane layout handling, and fragment management for showing item details.

classes.name: FragmentLayout
classes.description: Main Activity demonstrating fragment-based layouts and secondary activity handling.

classes.name: FragmentLayout.DetailsActivity
classes.description: Secondary activity for showing details when screen space is limited.

classes.name: FragmentLayout.TitlesFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment showing item titles and handling user selection to display details.

classes.name: FragmentLayout.DetailsFragment
classes.description: A fragment displaying detailed text, dynamically created based on selected item.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the main activity, setting the content view.

methods.name: DetailsActivity.onCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of the details activity, finishing immediately in landscape mode and setting up the details fragment otherwise.

methods.name: TitlesFragment.onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up the list of titles, checks for dual-pane layout, restores state, and configures list view behavior.

methods.name: TitlesFragment.onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item click events, showing details accordingly.

methods.name: TitlesFragment.showDetails
methods.description: Displays selected item details, either via fragment replacement or launching a new activity.

methods.name: DetailsFragment.newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new fragment instance initialized with the specified index.

methods.name: DetailsFragment.getShownIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the index of the item being displayed.

methods.name: DetailsFragment.onCreateView
methods.description: Creates the fragment's view hierarchy, displaying detailed text within a ScrollView.
